summary: Delta review of dfe43659..fa379660. No blocker or major findings. npm test 61/61 green. Locked test/arson.test.js is untouched; the only test change is the new test/arson-extra.test.js, which uses expected values from literals and independent helpers (touches/openBox/edgeDist), not the sim's own code. Mutation check in a scratch copy (repo untouched): removing freeBodies from ignite fails the two eviction tests; disabling the leaveR rule fails the supporter test; disabling the scare rule fails the townsperson test; a Math.random in the fire entry fails the mid-burn determinism test. Eviction (nearestOpenTile/freeBodies) is deterministic (fixed neighbour order, first-best tie-break), bounded (8 levels), and cheap (runs only on ignite, release and backup). D-20 scare/leave rules are documented in sim.js, README and tested; D-19/D-20 not contradicted. Previous findings: FIRE_TICKS duplicate fixed (fire entries carry ticks, render reads f.ticks); G.targets rename fixed (supporterProps, GLOSSARY updated; the non-enumerable getter alias is commented, tied to the locked test, and accepted by the judge); fireTiles now used by sim.js; drawCharred reads t.ang from the copied props. Still open from before: render draw paths untested, BIKE_TANK visual change.
